spans.s:
vṛddha (LP), participle of vṛdh, ‘to cut’.
 Cf. Vṛddha-Gaṇeśa (IA 19), ‘the senior Gaṇeśa’.
Vṛddha-dhānuṣka (IE 8-3), senior archer; the chief archer.
Vṛddharāja (EI 3; LL), ‘prosperous king’; title of a pious king.
vṛddhi (EI 28), a super tax or the interest on arrears of taxes; also interest.
vṛddhi-kukkuṭa (CII 1), Prakrit vadhi-kukuṭa; a cock that has been caponed; also Sanskritised as vadhri-kukkuṭa.
